items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: E"S, meaning AK, its lights cannot clothe in the vessels of reception of Atzilut, which are from the aspect of the reflected light of the Malchut of restriction 2, as above in answer 125. Rather, it clothes in the vessels of reception of Atik, which too are from the reflected light of the Malchut of restriction 1, like AK. Thus E"S, which is AK, cannot truly clothe except in the RDL"A, which is equal to it in the aspect of the vessels. (Vol. 1, p. 301, Item 9).
